headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief: 7 Oct 2026
summary: Ethereum holds the largest chain TVL at $52.96bn, followed by Solana and Base. Uniswap V4 leads DEX volumes while Tether generates the highest protocol fees. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin supply, though several peg deviations are noted. Base and Arbitrum lead L2 TVS metrics amid recent incidents including a $387m Bitget key compromise.

sections.title: Chains & TVL
bullets: Ethereum leads with $52.96bn TVL; Solana at $6.53bn and Base at $6.32bn.
BSC ($5.70bn), Tron ($5.63bn) and Bitcoin ($4.50bn) complete the top six.
Arbitrum ($1.42bn) and Hyperliquid L1 ($1.15bn) rank seventh and eighth.

sections.title: DEX & fees
bullets: Uniswap V4 recorded $1.28bn 24h volume; Uniswap V3 followed at $986m.
Aerodrome Slipstream on Base achieved $631m 24h volume.
Tether generated $17.46m fees; Circle USDC $7.09m; PumpSwap $4.47m.

sections.title: Stablecoins
bullets: USYC trades at $1.139 (13.94% deviation); several other peg alerts active.
USDe supply rose 13.56% over 30 days to $4.96bn.

sections.title: L2s
bullets: OP Mainnet TVS $1.93bn with 0.186% 7d change on Base.

sections.title: Security
bullets: Bitget suffered $387m hot-wallet compromise on 24 Sep.
NEAR Intents bridge incident $3.8m on 1 Oct; Duelbits $7m on 24 Sep.
Set Protocol and MakerDAO incidents reported on 6 Oct.

watchlist: USYC and USDY peg deviations above 13%
